turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, and my son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided that, and did anyone call me first?
I'm waiting, Hale. "Mm-hm" isn't an answer, and the clock is running.
You've said "Mm-hm" twice now, Hale. Either you tell me on what basis Owen got that zero, or I walk down the hall to the principal's office right now.
Are you finished? Because I stopped listening about five minutes ago.

"I stopped listening about five minutes ago." I'm writing that down, Hale, word for word. The zero comes off today, I get an apology, and you give me whatever you're holding against Owen's essay, or that sentence goes to the principal with everything else.
